about_the_game:
PLAY THE UPDATED "WIP" DEMO!
Its fun and cheesy, honestly!

A unique narrative investigation game, somewhere between Ace Attorney and Criminal Minds.

Yep, quite a gap, right?

As a young FBI agent freshly landed in the field, you will face all sorts of situations and encounter a variety of characters. Your choices, your intuition and your deductions will dictate the course of the story.

How you interact with characters, the clues you find at crime scenes, and the psychological analysis you perform on suspects, victims, and other protagonists will determine the progression of the adventure, the success or failure of each investigation... and, of course, the outcome of the game and the central arc of Profiler Files.

  • Branching narrative with multiple endings, within each episode and at the final resolution.

  • Point-and-click investigation.

  • Colorful characters and plenty of humor... which doesn't prevent serious, sometimes even grave, themes worthy of the best crime series.

content_descriptors.notes: Some themes in the game may be serious and disturbing, including sexual innuendos, references to drugs and alcohol, and depictions of reprehensible criminal acts, etc. If addressed with humor and subtlety and not intended to shock, we want to caution players about their potentially unsettling nature.

detailed_description:
Just Updated

Hello everyone,

We’re excited to share our roadmap for the coming months. Development is moving forward , and here’s what we have in store for you:

🗓️ 2025

- Complete overhaul of Episode 1 and the demo with brand-new visuals.

- Migration to a new game engine, for a smoother and more immersive experience.

- 🗓️ 2026 – First Half

- Completion of half the episodes for the full version.

- Customization of the user interface for intuitive navigation.

- Full translation of the content in English, to reach an international audience.

🗓️ 2026 – Second Half

- Early Access launch on Steam, accompanied by a new demo.

- Writing the remaining episodes while testing and debugging the earlier ones.

- Translation of the final episodes.

- Composition, recording, and integration of the original soundtrack.

🗓️ Early 2027

Official release of the commercial Version 1.0 🎉

Thank you for your support and patience.

Every step brings us closer to delivering a game that’s rich, alive... and VERY fun.

Stay tuned so you don’t miss any upcoming announcements!

See you soon !

Oh, by the way...
THE DEMO HAS BEEN UPDATED with a NEW "WIP VERSION" !
